name: Details
layerWhy: It lays out facts about one thing; reading facts is not a job.
promise: Each term is followed by its value.
expectation: Terms muted, values beside them, stacked on a phone.
evidence: A real description list; long values wrap.
behaviour: Two columns where there is room, one on a phone.
failures: Never a table for one record.
do: Keep terms the same across records.
dont: Details for a list of many things.
